notes: The standing component list for the version-currency re-verification ritual: all L4 systems (TSS section 7 register, TC-010..TC-039 incl. the D-028/D-030 replacements), the L1 platform, the L2/L3 classes, the cross-cutting app-platform runtimes, and the L6 commercial set. check.type: endoflife (endoflife.date cycle EOL), github (upstream repo liveness + latest release), or manual (facts carried from a dated human verification). Replacements are recorded against the original TC id so the register stays traceable to the TSS.

components.name: Odoo Community Edition
components.notes: Odoo 20 shipped at Odoo Experience Brussels 24-26 Sep 2026; upgrade slot W6 (P09-M02). Odoo 19 standard support to ~Sep 2028 (manual fact, verified 2026-10-01).

components.name: OCA subtrees (18 repositories)
components.notes: Pins verified per-subtree at P02-M04-T06 against versions.lock; not individually network-checkable here.

components.name: Free third-party Odoo modules
components.notes: TSS section 6 register; adoption rule applies per module.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.notes: EOL 8 Nov 2029 (month ~37 on Q4-2026 kickoff). PG18 (EOL 14 Nov 2030) re-opened at P09-M02-T01.

components.name: Redis / Valkey (D-031 pending)
components.licence: BSD-3 (<=7.2 only); 7.4+ RSALv2/SSPL; 8.x adds AGPLv3; Valkey BSD-3
components.notes: TSS TC-012 licence column (7.x = BSD-3) is WRONG for 7.4+. No 7.4+/8.x image may be pinned until D-031. Valkey = BSD-3 Linux Foundation fork.

components.name: Keycloak
components.notes: 26.x line current (26.7.x Aug 2026); minor-release back-compat guaranteed from 26.0. Community has no formal LTS product - manual fact, verified 2026-10-01.

components.name: Workflow orchestration (was n8n)
components.notes: Orchestration use case only; INT-047 business-process automation gap needs its own ADR if material.

components.name: Object storage (was MinIO)
components.notes: minio/minio archived upstream 25 Apr 2026 (see watch list).

components.name: TimescaleDB
components.notes: TSL-licensed features must never be enabled - licence gate tests this.

components.name: Grafana
components.notes: Approved: internal operational monitoring only; never a multi-tenant offering.

components.name: Loki
components.notes: Approved: behind the trust boundary; no third-party log service.

components.name: Tempo
components.notes: Same class as Loki.

components.name: BI (was Metabase)
components.notes: P06 embeds Superset without source-provision duties.

components.name: Remote support (MeshCentral / RustDesk)
components.notes: Prefer the Apache-2.0 arm (MeshCentral) where the Wave-5 pilot choice is neutral.

components.name: Wazuh
components.notes: GPL-2 not in the D-030 approval class (not AGPL/BSL/TSL/fair-code); no outbound aggregation.

components.name: ClamAV
components.notes: NFR-063 P0 malware scanning.

components.name: Secrets vault (Vault / OpenBao)
components.notes: HashiCorp Vault is BUSL (D-030 approval class) - OpenBao (MPL-2.0 fork) preferred; Wave 1 pick recorded in D-030.

components.name: Next.js
components.notes: Next.js 15 EOL 21 Oct 2026. 16 Active LTS ~3 years.

components.name: Payload CMS
components.notes: 3.73 = the Next.js 16 support release (23 Jan 2026); 4.0 in canary - ADR when stable.

components.name: Node.js
components.notes: FINDING: BE-001 pins Node 20 LTS but Node 20 went EOL 30 Apr 2026. P02-M02-T02 must install Node 22 (Maintenance LTS, EOL Apr 2027); Node 24 = Active LTS. Payload 3.73 requires >= 20.9, satisfied on 22.

components.name: Python
components.notes: Matches the Odoo container runtime minor.

components.name: Flutter
components.notes: 3.44: Material/Cupertino -> standalone material_ui/cupertino_ui packages; Impeller default on Android; Dart 3.12. Read migration notes BEFORE pinning (P02-M02-T03).

components.name: Cloud telephony / CPaaS (TC-070)
components.notes: Asterisk/FreePBX assessed viable but requires carrier expertise; revisit at renewal.

components.name: Qualified e-signature (TC-071)
components.notes: Accredited trust-service status is the point; no OSS equivalent.

components.name: Identity verification / KYC (TC-072)
components.notes: Requires an accredited data source; no OSS equivalent exists.

components.name: Endpoint RMM agent (TC-073)
components.notes: Deferred to a Wave 5 pilot; Wazuh + osquery cover monitoring.

watchList.reason: Archived 25 Apr 2026 (IRB-01). The ritual's regression check: this must keep reporting archived.
